title: BRS and Left parties protest against government land auction in Hyderabad
seoTitle: Hyderabad BRS protest against land auction

tea.why: Opposition parties are protesting the government's decision to auction public land, including a truck park in Kukatpally.
tea.want: The protesters demand the immediate cancellation of the upcoming government land e-auction.
tea.changed: Nov 25: Police detained several BRS leaders and activists, including an MLA and an MLC, following a sit-in protest in Ameerpet.

summary: On November 25, 2026, members of the Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) and various Left parties, including the CPI, CPI(M), and CPI(ML) New Democracy, held a protest at the Hyderabad Metropolitan Development Authority (HMDA) office in Ameerpet. The demonstration aimed to oppose the government's planned e-auction of public lands, specifically the Kukatpally HUDA truck park. Protesters argued that selling the land would exacerbate traffic congestion and negatively impact local livelihoods. The event involved a sit-in on the main road, which caused significant traffic disruptions. Police intervened to clear the area, resulting in the detention of several prominent figures, including MLA Madhavaram Krishna Rao and MLC Shambipur Raju. Senior BRS leaders condemned the detentions and called for the immediate release of those taken into custody while criticising the government's land sale policy.
organizers: Communist Party of India (Marxist-Leninist) New Democracy
demands: Retain the truck park land for transport or public amenities
response: Police made security arrangements, barricaded roads near the HMDA office, and detained several protesters, including an MLA and an MLC, to clear the area.
